1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Two broad slow seals; weak currents and fast flask response; one drifting raft.
1.natural_language: Brew the numbered effect seals in order. Jar courses are concealed: sample a jar in the mortar to learn its course, then use the retained marks and local preview to choose ingredients and grind. Shelf order varies by brew. Sampling and previews are safe before LIGHT CAULDRON; while lit, the atlas keeps moving during inspection. Grinding bends a course clockwise by up to 90 degrees. Stir controls propulsion and water pulls toward the origin. Currents, seals and bone rafts keep moving after LIGHT CAULDRON. Keep the whole flask inside a seal, moving slowly relative to it, until its ring fills. Bone or rim contact loses the brew. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage.
